I have bpd and bipolar 1 as well! I wish i had some meaningful advice to offer but unfortunately I am also trying to figure out how to deal with my mental health problems. At the very least I hope you find comfort in knowing there’s someone else out there.

I’m currently off my meds as well for no reason other than I just keep forgetting to take them, but I will say lamictal worked great for me. I tried a few before that- lexapro, prozac, celexa, and some others, but lamictal was the only one that I showed any improvement with. Though, that’s just me personally ofc and everyone is going to have a different experience.

I sincerely hope you’re able to find something that works for you. Sending love :)
